_comment: Every lookup table the Service Mapping Engine uses. Edit these to retune recommendations — no code change needed. See ../../service-mapping-model.md for the reasoning behind each table and worked examples.

excludedClassifications.Ignore: Not routed anywhere; not a consulting engagement to map.
excludedClassifications.Convert into Content: Content Director's signal, not a service engagement — mapping this would duplicate Content Director's own decision.
excludedClassifications.Convert into Product Idea: Product Manager's signal, not a service engagement — mapping this would duplicate Product Manager's own decision.

crossSellComplement._note: The one complementary Primary Service recommended after any engagement in this row's key, chosen to be genuinely different in shape from the primary (e.g. an assessment-led engagement cross-sells a workshop; a workshop cross-sells an assessment).

proposalTemplateByDomainTag._note: Checked before proposalTemplateByPrimaryService — a direct domainTag match to a dedicated real template (templates/proposals/) is always more specific than a Primary Service default.

projectSizeDefaultByPrimaryService._note: Used only when pipeline.json has no real, parseable expectedRevenue for this opportunity yet. Adjusted afterward by scores.expectedRevenue (the 0-10 dimension every opportunity already has) — see service-mapping-model.md.

projectSizeRevenueThresholds._note: Applied to the parsed numeric value of pipeline.json's expectedRevenue when a real, parseable figure exists (parse_currency(), reused verbatim from executive-dashboard/runtime/generate.py). Thresholds are applied to the raw number regardless of currency label — a documented simplification, the same one executive-dashboard's own revenue section already accepts (see its 'mixed_currency_note'), not a new gap this engine introduces.
